For information only — not financial advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your total wedding budget.
  2. Adjust each category's % of budget (defaults follow common planning guides).
  3. Add or remove categories to match your plans.
  4. Watch the allocated total and remaining budget update live.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Do the percentages have to add to 100?

No, but if they don't, the allocated total will differ from your budget and the tool shows the gap so you can rebalance.

Are the default percentages rules?

No, they are common planning guides. Every wedding is different; adjust freely.

What is the contingency for?

Unexpected costs. Planners often reserve 5-15% of the budget for overruns.
